subject: Offline deployment decision matrix & ops constraints — post-call notes
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lane <jordan.lane@aperionbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Offline deployment decision matrix & ops constraints — post-call notes

Jordan — thanks again for the call earlier. Below is a concise recap with the queue of open items we discussed. I wanted to make sure we captured the deployment decision tradeoffs (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private/offline) and the operational constraints your team flagged so we can move to a formal proposal.

Quick recap (from our call):
- Preferred outcome: Full feature parity with Redwood runtime, but must run in an air-gapped cluster on-prem due to PHI/regulated workflows.
- Primary constraints: no outbound internet, limited rack power (11kW per 42U rack), strict maintenance blackout windows, and approval process for firmware updates.
- Timeline: pilot environment needed in Q1 2028; production by end of Q2 2028.

Open questions & next steps (action owners):
1) Hardware profile confirmation (Aperion ops): we need exact CPU/GPU counts and rack power per host to size node types. (Action: Jordan — share latest rack inventory CSV)
2) Spare parts / spares policy: clarify on-call replacement SLA and whether Aperion will stock hot spares vs request cross-shipment. (Action: Jordan + Avery Systems)
3) Offline upgrade path: we outlined two approaches — USB-based image + documented MOP versus staged airgapped package delivered on encrypted media. We need to know procurement lead times and any restrictions on removable media. (Action: Marissa to propose two upgrade MOPs)
4) Entitlement & access: list of Redwood users who will require console access (breakglass) and whether SAML is available within the private network. (Action: Jordan)
5) Compliance artifacts: SOC2/Audit packaging expectations for on-prem — what evidence will Aperion need from Redwood for the validation? (Action: Priyom)

Attachments: I attached a blank site-survey template and a decision-matrix draft to help structure answers. Please return the site survey and any inventory exports by EOD next Tuesday so we can finalize the pilot BOM.

If anything above is wrong or missing, flag and I’ll update. Next sync: propose 30m on Tue 11/9 to align on inventory and spare policy.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
[Attachment: site-survey-template.xlsx (Excel)]
[Attachment: offline-deploy-decision-matrix.pdf (PDF)]
From: Jordan Lane <jordan.lane@aperionbio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Avery Systems (ops) <ops@averysys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Offline deployment decision matrix & ops constraints — post-call notes

Ben — thanks for the summary and the templates. Quick answers inline: 

- Inventory: attaching a partial rack export (will deliver full CSV by Friday). We currently have 3 racks earmarked for the pilot, each listed as ~10kW usable power after PDUs and cooling headroom.
- Spares: we keep N+1 critical spares onsite (GPU cards + spare host). We can extend to a small hot-spare pool if required. Cross-shipment from vendor takes ~72 business hours.
- Removable media: procurement has strict policies — removable media is allowed but must be cryptographically sealed and approved by security.
- SAML: yes, we have an internal Okta instance; full SAML can be exposed into the private VPC with an IdP connector.
- Compliance artifacts: we will need an engineer-level runbook and the list of firmware hashes used for any image delivered.

Attaching the partial inventory export. I can do Tue 11/9 at 10:30am PST for the alignment call.

Jordan
Head of Infrastructure, Aperion Bio
[jordan.lane@aperionbio.com]
[Attachment: aperion-partial-inventory.csv (CSV)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lane <jordan.lane@aperionbio.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Offline deployment decision matrix & ops constraints — post-call notes

Jordan — great context, thanks. A few immediate clarifications from the ops side as we size the pilot nodes: 
- We can propose two node SKUs: (A) 8x A100 80GB per host (higher density) and (B) 4x A40 + 2x 80GB NVMe cache drives (lower power). Given your ~10kW per rack, SKU B may be more realistic for the pilot.
- For firmware/update MOPs: Marissa will draft both workflows — one where we ship an encrypted image on an HSM-wrapped SSD and one where we provide a signed patch bundle that your security team pulls from a vetted bastion host during a maintenance window. Both will include firmware hashes and reproducible checks.
- Hot-swap policy: for pilot we recommend one hot spare per rack; for production we’ll model N+2 depending on criticality.

Action: Ben / Priyom — can you create the upgrade MOP draft and the signed-bundle checklist by Thursday so Jordan can engage procurement?

Marissa
Principal Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lane <jordan.lane@aperionbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Offline deployment decision matrix & ops constraints — post-call notes

Jordan — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and the partial inventory. We’ll proceed with these items: 
1) Priyom will assemble the SOC2-related packaging and the list of artifacts Aperion will need for their validation (runbook, firmware hashes, access logs).
2) I’ll draft two upgrade MOPs (encrypted media image + signed bundle) and circulate by EOD Thursday.
3) Marissa will include two BOM alternatives (SKU A and SKU B) with power/thermal estimates.

Next touch: Tue 11/9 10:30am PST — calendar invite to follow. If the inventory CSV arrives earlier we’ll try to pre-size the BOM before the call. 

Thanks — and Jordan, if you prefer a short operations working session with your on-site Avery Systems team prior to 11/9, we can schedule a 60m deep-dive.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
